svg.font-family: Poppins, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The no-code sticker price is a floor; the meters sit on top of it
svg.desc: A stack. At the bottom, your monthly plan, the price on the pricing page. Stacked above it: workload units on Bubble, extra editors at 20 dollars a month on Framer and 5 dollars a user on Glide, bandwidth blocks at 20 dollars per 50 GB on Webflow, and tasks and credits on Zapier, Make and Softr. Your bill becomes a function of your traffic.
svg.text: THE STICKER PRICE IS THE FLOOR
+ Tasks and credits — Zapier, Make, Softr
Your monthly plan, the price on the page
Your bill is a functionof your traffic.
The successful version of yourproject costs more than thefailed one.
Adalo is the loud counterexample:it markets flat pricing with nousage-based charges.
Compare three years, not one month, and model the meter at the traffic you are hoping for.
